entries.46761a63b31b8452: This business operates the beef bowl chain Sukiya directly in Japan, China, Southeast Asia and Central and South America. It serves a wide range of customers, including families and groups, with safe and tasty products at affordable prices, centered on its main beef bowl. It is operated by Sukiya Co., Ltd. and overseas subsidiaries such as Izumisei Catering (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., Taiwan Shanshang Co., Ltd., ZENSHO (THAILAND) CO., LTD. and ZENSHO DO BRASIL COMERCIO DE ALIMENTOS LTDA. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥314,454 million (up 6.3% year on year), and its share of group revenue was 24.9%. Operating profit was ¥9,317 million (down 62.0%). The number of stores at fiscal year-end was 2,650 (2,000 in Japan and 650 overseas), with 112 stores opened and 83 closed during the period. During this period, in addition to implementing beef bowl price cuts, it continued its health and safety measures following a foreign-matter contamination incident at some domestic stores at the end of the prior fiscal year, including strengthened cleaning and planned renovation of aging stores.

entries.4e44cddc1f0ba32e: This business operates sushi takeout stores and similar outlets, mainly in Europe and the United States, through directly operated stores and franchises (FC). The main brands are "AFC" and "ZENSHI" of Advanced Fresh Concepts Corp., "sushicircle" of Sushi Circle Gastronomie GmbH, and "SNOWFOX", "Bento", "Taiko", "YO!" and "SNOWFRUIT" of Wonderfield TopCo Limited. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the overseas takeout sushi business, which had previously been included in "Global Fast Food", is separated and disclosed in this segment (the prior year's figures are also restated into the new segment). Sales to external customers were ¥221,895 million (up 5.7% year on year), and the share of group sales was 17.6%. Operating profit was ¥27,376 million (up 7.0%). The number of stores at the end of the period was 8,970 (including FC8,102 stores); 761 stores were opened and 1,306 stores were closed as store replacements based on profitability and location conditions.

entries.53b2545369346362: This business operates various kinds of fast food in Japan and overseas, including "Nakau" (oyakodon and Kyoto-style udon) and "Zetteria" (hamburgers). Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥112,818 million (up 8.3% year on year), and the share of group sales was 8.9%. Operating profit was ¥3,310 million (down 7.3%). The company is reviewing its mix of store formats and making store operations more efficient; it advanced conversion openings to the hamburger chain "Zetteria", and closed all stores of the Sanuki udon specialty shop "Seto Udon" and the cafe chain "Moriba Coffee". The number of stores at the end of the period was 1,145 (including 880 in Japan, 265 overseas and FC57 stores); 31 stores were opened and 103 stores were closed during the period.

entries.61039bd8c82abea6: This is a business that operates supermarkets and sells fresh produce. Joy Mart Co., Ltd. operates supermarkets such as 'Maruya' and 'Joy Foods', mainly in northern Kanto, and United Vegies Co., Ltd. sells fresh produce and carries out related activities. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥76,977 million (up 1.2% year on year), and its share of group revenue was 6.1%. The operating loss was ¥1,025 million (the operating loss in the prior-year period was ¥1,794 million). The number of stores at the end of the period was 120, and six stores were closed during the period.
entries.7127a86d6f697cf8: This business operates restaurants mainly in Japan, including the family restaurant "COCO'S" and restaurants serving hamburger steaks and steaks, pasta, yakiniku (grilled meat), Italian cuisine and Japanese food. Directly operated stores are the core, and "COCO'S" is operated through both directly operated stores and franchises (FC). Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥171,281 million (up 9.7% year on year), and the share of group sales was 13.6%. Operating profit was ¥12,998 million (up 14.1%). The number of stores at the end of the period was 1,181 (including 1,180 in Japan, 1 overseas and FC76 stores); 6 stores were opened and 11 stores were closed during the period.

entries.f127428381bee0c1: This business operates the sushi chain Hama Sushi directly in Japan, China and other countries. In addition to sushi made with fresh seafood, it offers side menus including noodles, desserts and drinks, so that everyone from children to adults can enjoy the meal. It is operated by Hama Sushi Co., Ltd. and overseas subsidiaries such as Izumisei Catering (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Taiwan Shanshang Co., Ltd. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥320,277 million (up 28.9% year on year), the largest among the reportable segments, and its share of group revenue was 25.3%. Operating profit was ¥26,771 million (up 25.4%). The number of stores at fiscal year-end was 862 (664 in Japan and 198 overseas), with 132 stores opened and 5 closed during the period.
